title: Perpetual Spinach - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Pick and Come Again Spinach
description:
Grow Your Own Delicious, Hardy, Cut-and-Come-Again Spinach!


KEY FEATURES
• High Yield: 'Cut-and-come-again' harvesting for continuous fresh leaves.
• Bolting Resistance: Excellent resistance to bolting, even in warm, dry weather.
• Versatile: Ideal for salads, cooking, smoothies, and juices.
• Easy to Grow: Suitable for beginners, thrives in sun or partial shade.
• Hardy: Can crop through autumn and winter in many regions, lasting up to two years.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Beta vulgaris subsp. cicla var. cicla 'Perpetual Spinach'
Colour: Green foliage
Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter
Growth Habit: Bushy, Clump forming
Flavour: Mild, earthy, similar to traditional spinach
Time to Harvest: Approx. 8 weeks for young leaves, continuous thereafter


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun, Partial shade
Soil: Clay, Loam (Moist but well-drained)
Watering: Medium (keep watered in dry conditions)
Spacing: 0.1–0.5 metres
Height: 0.1–0.5 metres
Spread: 0.1–0.5 metres
Hardiness: H4


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in fertile soil, enriched with compost or well-rotted manure.
• Water regularly, especially during dry spells, to encourage lush growth.
• Harvest outer leaves regularly using a sharp knife or scissors to promote continuous production.
• Protect from slugs and caterpillars, especially when plants are young.
• Can be grown in pots or containers on patios and balconies.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
